items.x: The EPA's response to the 2023 East Palestine train derailment will be investigated after local residents of the small town on the Ohio-Pennsylvania border and VP JD Vance pressed for the review.

items.t: Dolores Huerta, civil rights icon and United Farm Workers co-founder, dies at 96
items.x: Labor and civil rights activist Dolores Huerta, who co-founded the organization that became the United Farm Workers, has died at 96.

items.t: Wendy's, struggling with beef prices and growing competition, gets buyout offer
